matchChannelColorsHint: Color waveforms to match their channel colors.
renameTabToSavedCapture: When saving a capture rename tab to saved capture filename

editor.name: Theme name
editor.startHint: Built-in themes are read-only. Copy one to edit interface colors, the eight-color palette and individual channels.
editor.draftHint: Unsaved draft. Cancel, Escape or closing Preferences restores the saved colors.
editor.paletteHint: Digital and analog channels repeat colors by physical index. Independent colors do not follow palette changes.
editor.noDevice: Select a device or open a capture to configure its channels. The base palette is always editable.
editor.overrideHint: Saved by device model and channel layout, retained across theme changes. Set a color to override; restore inheritance to follow the palette.
editor.expand: Freeze filtered channels as independent colors
editor.confirmDelete: Delete custom theme ‘{{name}}’? Device channel overrides will be retained.
editor.confirmClear: Clear all overrides for this device and restore palette inheritance?
editor.confirmExpand: Freeze the filtered channels as independent colors? They will no longer follow palette changes.
editor.confirmReset: Restore interface colors and the eight-color palette to the base theme? Channel overrides will be retained.
editor.fileTooLarge: The file must be smaller than 256 KB
editor.imported: Imported as a new draft. Apply to save. Imported device overrides are merged into the draft.
editor.textContrast: Warning: primary text/panel contrast is below 4.5:1.
editor.waveContrast: Warning: some channel/background contrast ratios are below 3:1.
